column1: # 1. nothing ever set: every launch path goes straight through, kids mode shows every app
# lists kept but no PIN (turned off with pin off): still nothing asks, kids mode is not on
# 2. a PIN and nothing locked: only the parental screen asks
# 3. one app locked: only the paths that open that app ask (its tile, its row, a pill that opens it)
# the same app opened from the sources list (live TV) asks too
# 4. each pill, by its own lock
# 5. «قفل الإعدادات»: the long-press menu, its arrange row and the arrange screen
# 6. the parental screen always asks once a PIN is set (it has no toggle), and once opened with the PIN not again until the home screen is back
# 7. an app opened with the PIN does not ask again until the home screen comes back; other locked apps still ask
# a pill opened with the PIN and the app it opens: both are open for the visit
# the app menu's «تفاصيل التطبيق» and «حذف التطبيق» (MENU_APP): «قفل الإعدادات», the TV's settings' lock or the app's own lock each ask
# 9. kids mode: only the allowed apps; off, every app
# kids mode hides apps from the screen; it does not lock a pill, and a locked app that is allowed still asks
# 11. the remote's shortcut keys (YouTube, Netflix, Settings): nothing set goes straight through; a locked app or the locked «الإعدادات» pill still asks
# «مركز التحكم»: opening the panel asks about @center only; the tiles that open something keep their own pills' locks
# `dock.sh pin lock/unlock`: what may be named, and what `pin status` says about a kept list
